presets.LINK: Button (Blank). Text on, Segoe UI 11 pt, Cobalt #1936E8 in every state, fill off, border off. Underline on hover if your editor offers it.
presets.RESET: Button (Reset icon, from Insert > Buttons > Reset). Text on: 'Reset filters', Segoe UI 11 pt, Cobalt #1936E8, right aligned; icon Cobalt, placed left of the text, about 14 px; fill and border off.

presets.FIGURE: Card (new). Callout value Segoe UI Semibold 23 pt, Onyx #000000, left, vertical middle, no word wrap. Display units None (so 172,239 does not become 172K), decimals from the measure. Label off. Card background, border, shadow and accent bar off; padding 0.
presets.BASE: Card (new). Callout value Segoe UI 11 pt, Muted #66655F, left, vertical middle, no word wrap. Display units None (so 172,239 does not become 172K), decimals from the measure. Label off. Card background, border, shadow and accent bar off; padding 0.
presets.TITLE: Card (new). Callout value Segoe UI Semibold 15 pt, Onyx #000000, vertical middle, no word wrap. Display units None (so 172,239 does not become 172K), decimals from the measure. Label off. Card background, border, shadow and accent bar off; padding 0.
presets.LABEL-INK: Card (new). Callout value Segoe UI 11 pt, Ink #303A39, vertical middle, no word wrap. Display units None (so 172,239 does not become 172K), decimals from the measure. Label off. Card background, border, shadow and accent bar off; padding 0.
presets.TILES: Button slicer. Slicer header on (field renamed as given), Segoe UI 11 pt Muted #66655F. Buttons: one row, spacing 0, text Segoe UI 11 pt centred. Default: fill #F7F5EC, text Ink #303A39. On hover and On press: fill #E3DECF, text Onyx. Selected: fill Ink #303A39, text Shell #FFFFFF. Border 1 px Axis #CFCBBD. Selection: Single select on, Force selection on.
presets.DROPDOWN: Slicer (the classic slicer), style Dropdown. Header on (field renamed as given), Segoe UI 11 pt Muted. Values Segoe UI 11 pt Onyx on Card #F7F5EC, 1 px Axis #CFCBBD border (the theme sets these). Selection: Single select off, Multi-select with Ctrl off (clicks tick the check boxes), Show Select all on. Shows All when nothing is picked.
presets.TABLE: Table. Style preset None. Grid: horizontal and vertical gridlines off, row padding 4 (28 px rows). Column headers Segoe UI 11 pt Muted on Card, word wrap on. Values Segoe UI 11 pt Onyx on Card for both row colours (no banding). Totals off unless stated. Auto-size column width off, then drag the column widths given.
presets.CHART: Title, background, border and shadow off (theme). Legend off, gridlines off, axis titles off unless stated.
